content.title: Chapter 2
content.subtitle: SUSTAINABLE ENERGY FOR CLIMATE MITIGATION
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the second chapter of the Climate Change-Energy Nexus Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 3: Sustainable Energy for Climate Adaptation
nextBlock.cta: This chapter explores how sustainable energy supports climate adaptation through resilience-building, decentralized systems, inclusive planning, and strategies addressing vulnerable communities and infrastructure.
